# RM brief — ABDUL CORPORATION LTD (09737739)
*as of 2026-09-30 · research passes: 1*

**Decision: REFER** — set by CON-04 — Micro-entity accounts  
**Qualifies as a lead:** yes

## Summary

- ABDUL CORPORATION LTD (company number 09737739) is an active private limited company incorporated on 18 August 2015, around 11 years of trading history, operating under SIC code 86900 (other human health activities). It has three active officers, with no new appointments in the last 12 months. `[profile; officers; computed]`
- No charges are registered at Companies House, so the company holds a clean security position and a first-charge facility could be offered subject to the remaining policies. `[SEC-02]`
- Filing conduct is strong: accounts have been filed early in almost every year, including the latest to 31 March 2025 filed 13 October 2025, some 76 days ahead of the deadline. The only late filing was the 2021 accounts, submitted seven days past due. `[AA filed 2025-10-13; AA filed 2024-10-23; AA filed 2022-01-04]`
- Accounts are up to date and not overdue, with the next set due 31 December 2026; note the most recent accounts are made up to 31 March 2025, roughly 18 months old as at the review date. `[profile; computed]`
- The case is a REFER under CON-04 because the latest accounts were filed on the total exemption full basis, which does not disclose turnover or profit and is insufficient on its own to assess serviceability. `[CON-04; AA filed 2025-10-13]`
- Before any decision, obtain management accounts covering the most recent 12 months; earlier filings were on a micro-entity basis, so historic comparatives will also be limited. `[CON-04; AA filed 2023-11-01; AA filed 2022-12-14]`
